description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDecorator class, which provides methods to decorate and manipulate EmployeeMembership entities within the OrangeHRM system. The class offers functionality to set employee and membership references, format subscription dates, and retrieve currency names, utilizing service traits and external services.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeMembership entities providing methods to set references and retrieve formatted data related to employee memberships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeMembership instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeMembership entity being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference for the EmployeeMembership based on employee number.

methods.name: setMembershipByMembershipId
methods.description: Sets the Membership reference for the EmployeeMembership based on membership ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the subscription commence date.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the subscription renewal date.

methods.name: getCurrencyName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the subscription currency via the PayGradeService.
